question: ABC Heating and Cooling operates in a jurisdiction that prohibits unreasonable workplace searches and surveillance in areas or items where employees have a reasonable expectation of privacy. In which of the following areas or items would an employee at ABC MOST LIKELY have a reasonable expectation of privacy during a workplace search?

options.A: A compartment in a company vehicle used by authorized employees
options.B: An employee’s company-gifted backpack dial they bring to the office
options.C: A filing cabinet used exclusively by members of the employee’s department
options.D: An employee’s company-issued laptop that may be used to work from home

community_answer: B. An employee’s company-gifted backpack dial they bring to the office

question: For criminal cases in civil law systems, which of the following statements BEST describes the conviction intime standard for burden of proof?

options.A: The fact finder must be absolutely certain that the defendant is guilty of the charge.
options.B: The fact finder must be as certain as possible that the defendant is guilty of the charge.
options.C: The fact finder must be convinced by reasonable intuition that the defendant is guilty of the charge.
options.D: The fact finder must be convinced on an inner, deep-seated level that the defendant is guilty of the charge.

community_answer: D. The fact finder must be convinced on an inner, deep-seated level that the defendant is guilty of the charge.

question: Which of the following statements regarding the process for tracing assets associated with or derived from illicit transactions Is MOST ACCURATE?

options.A: The tracing process entails collecting information about the parties and transactions involved at a specific point in the investigation and then moving on to other steps.
options.B: Fraud examiners should evaluate the potential for asset recovery alter assets have been successfully traced.
options.C: The first step in the tracing process should be to profile the subject by assembling a financial and behavioral profile.
options.D: Fraud examiners should investigate every lead they uncover during the tracing process in the order received to ensure that they do not miss or overlook any important details.

community_answer: B. Fraud examiners should evaluate the potential for asset recovery alter assets have been successfully traced.

url: https://www.certlibrary.com/exam/CFE - Fraud Investigations and Legal Issues?page=1
question: Which of the following statements concerning judgments involving parties that are in multiple jurisdictions is MOST ACCURATE?

options.A: A judgment m a domestic jurisdiction can be enforced in a foreign jurisdiction only with the consent of both parties and the judge.
options.B: A judgment in a domestic jurisdiction can be used to recover a defendant’s assets in a foreign jurisdiction, regardless of the foreign jurisdiction.
options.C: A judgment in a foreign jurisdiction can be enforceable in a domestic jurisdiction if it involves criminal matters but not civil matters.
options.D: A judgment in one jurisdiction is enforceable against assets in another country if the foreign jurisdiction has laws or agreements that recognize foreign judgments.

community_answer: D. A judgment in one jurisdiction is enforceable against assets in another country if the foreign jurisdiction has laws or agreements that recognize foreign judgments.

question: During an internal investigation, Sam, a Certified Fraud Examiner (CFE), interviews a fellow employee named Jordan. Although Jordan wants to leave during the interview, Sam locks the door and proceeds with the interview. Jordan subsequently confesses to lapping customer payments. If Jordan files a lawsuit for false imprisonment against Sam, then Sam will likely:

options.A: Win the case if he did not know that the conduct was illegal
options.B: Lose the case because he was required to tell Jordan before the interview started of his obligation to cooperate as an employee
options.C: Win the case because he was acting in the interest of the company
options.D: Lose the case if a trier of fact concludes that his actions restrained Jordan without consent or legal justification

community_answer: D. Lose the case if a trier of fact concludes that his actions restrained Jordan without consent or legal justification

question: Ana, a fraud examiner, is preparing to conduct an interview with Wilbert as part of a fraud investigation at True West Inc. The human resources (HR) manager from True West Inc. has requested to be in the room during the interview. Which of the following statements is MOST ACCURATE regarding the presence of the HR manager during the interview?

options.A: If Ana believes that the HR manager will make Wilbert more comfortable, she may permit the manager to be present.
options.B: In most jurisdictions, Ana needs to ask Wilbert if he would like the HR manager to be present during the interview.
options.C: If permitted by law, Ana should not allow the HR manager to witness the interview to avoid liability consequences.
options.D: Ana may allow the HR manager to attend as long as they agree not to ask questions or participate in the interview.

community_answer: A. If Ana believes that the HR manager will make Wilbert more comfortable, she may permit the manager to be present.

question: Which of the following statements regarding data visualization is TRUE?

options.A: Geospatial analysis displays keywords of various sizes to indicate their frequency and level of importance.
options.B: Tree maps provide a hierarchical structure of data using rectangular space that is divided into regions.
options.C: Color-coding and compatibility are the objectives of communications involving data visualizations.
options.D: Link analysis depicts intersections between various data types and their corresponding geographical locations.

community_answer: B. Tree maps provide a hierarchical structure of data using rectangular space that is divided into regions.

question: Abigail, a fraud examiner at a private company, is investigating a coworker named Coraline who is suspected of committing an electronic payment tampering scheme. During the investigation, Abigail finds credible evidence that Coraline is having an affair with a married coworker and tells several colleagues. Coraline discovers that Abigail has revealed this true, but very unflattering, information about her and decides to file a claim of defamation against Abigail. Which of the following explanations BEST describes why Coraline will not win her defamation case?

options.A: Abigail informed her colleagues while Coraline was being actively investigated.
options.B: Abigail shared the information on a privileged occasion
options.C: Abigail communicated information that turned out to be true
options.D: Abigail did not communicate the information to anyone outside the company.

community_answer: C. Abigail communicated information that turned out to be true
